headline: Tesla delivers 480,000 vehicles in Q2 up 25% from last year
summary: Tesla's Q2 vehicle deliveries surge 25% year-over-year, beating Wall Street estimates
details: Tesla delivered roughly 480,000 vehicles globally in Q2, a 25 percent increase from a year ago. This marks the company's first year-over-year delivery growth in two years.

The bulk of these deliveries come from the Model 3 and Model Y vehicles, accounting for around 468,000 units. Other vehicles, including the Cybertruck and Model X, make up the remaining 12,000 deliveries.

The increase in sales may be attributed to rising fuel costs and new subsidies for EV adoption in Europe. Tesla recently announced a major expansion to its Gigafactory in Berlin, with a plan to increase production to 7,500 vehicles per week by October.
Despite the positive news, Tesla's stock tanked by around seven percent following the announcement.

headline: SpaceX to Acquire Cursor for $60 Billion with Uncertain Future
summary: The acquisition may impact Cursor's model-agnostic platform.
details: SpaceX announced its acquisition of Cursor, a popular AI coding startup, for $60 billion. The deal, expected to finalize later this year, raises questions about Cursor's future as an open platform for various AI models.
Cursor has historically allowed users to choose from models by Anthropic, OpenAI, and other AI labs. The startup hopes to continue this model-agnostic approach after the acquisition.
The acquisition could intensify rivalry between SpaceX and AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic, which have competing interests in the AI development space.
caption:
Can Cursor remain open with SpaceX at the helm?

SpaceX announced its acquisition of Cursor, a popular AI coding startup, for $60 billion. The deal, expected to finalize later this year, raises questions about Cursor's future as an open platform for various AI models.

Cursor has historically allowed users to choose from models by Anthropic, OpenAI, and other AI labs. The startup hopes to continue this model-agnostic approach after the acquisition.

The acquisition could intensify rivalry between SpaceX and AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic, which have competing interests in the AI development space.
